name: Dmitri Ingebrigtsen-Szabó
role: Network intrusion and digital warfare specialist — netrunner
location: Crucible Square — open-air market, Tier 1-2 commerce, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Dmitri Ingebrigtsen-Szabó is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 33, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ice in the brain — and he makes no effort to hide it.

His entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. He works as a netrunner out of Crucible Square, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Dmitri Ingebrigtsen-Szabó is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who he burned last.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
psychology.secret: Hadiya Forsberg-Ofosu betrayed their previous crew to survive a corporate raid. The crew didn't survive. Nobody in GLMZ knows this.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
Repeats the last thing someone said back to them before responding — processing or intimidation
example_lines: "Every system has a door. Most of them have a door the architect forgot about."
"I don't hack networks. I have conversations with them. Most of them are lonely."
"The ice they're running is military-grade. That means expensive, not impenetrable."

story_hooks: Someone is impersonating Hadiya Forsberg-Ofosu on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
Hadiya Forsberg-Ofosu is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A Tier 4 executive offers Hadiya Forsberg-Ofosu a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: As a netrunner, Hadiya Forsberg-Ofosu embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ICE in the brain. Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Southeast Asian (55.8%) with significant Eastern European (29.7%), East Asian (10.2%), and South Asian (4.3%) admixture. The genetic blend creates a distinctive pan-Asian appearance with strong Southeast Asian baseline: warm medium-brown skin with subtle golden undertones, refined by Eastern European bone structure complexity and East Asian refinement. High cheekbones and structured jaw reflect the convergence of multiple Asian and European lineages, with the Southeast Asian warmth dominating the overall visual impression.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature — wiry rather than bulk, built for precision and endurance rather than power. Chest and shoulders show the kind of tension that comes from years of controlled stress.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural bronze undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Worn short and functional, swept back from the face with minimal styling effort
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: warm brown, organic. Right eye: matte black with faint cyan circuit-line tracery, cybernetic.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm brown with golden undertones — the Southeast Asian genetic dominance (55.8%) creates rich depth and warmth, refined by Eastern European pale undertones and East Asian refinement into a cohesive warm-medium complexion.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, high cheekbones reflecting Southeast Asian heritage, structured jaw with defined bone structure influenced by Eastern European genetics. Skin shows warm medium-brown tone with subtle golden cast. Skin condition is clean but shows the wear of stress — faint lines around the eyes, the kind that come from squinting at screens in low light. No visible scarring on the face.
distinguishing_marks: Neural dampener port at the base of skull, just below the hairline — visible chrome backing plate, approximately 3cm diameter, with thin lead-gray wiring running downward into the spine.

Faint burn scarring along the left forearm, thin and precise — tool marks from an old intrusion attempt that went wrong, partially covered by a dark grey dataflow tattoo in kanji characters that runs wrist to elbow.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural dampener at base of skull with visible chrome backing and wiring. Right eye is cybernetic — matte black faceplate with faint circuit tracery, noticeably different from the warm brown of the left eye. No visible arm or leg augmentations.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Tends to keep his augmented eye side slightly forward in conversation, a habit born from always knowing where the threat is. When still, there is visible tension in his shoulders and jaw, like a coiled spring. Hands are steady, fingers occasionally twitching in small, unconscious patterns — muscle memory for keyboard work.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 practical — dark grey long-sleeve compression shirt fitted to his lean frame, worn under a matte black synthweave jacket with reinforced seams and interior pockets designed for hardware. Cargo pants in charcoal with multiple sealed pockets. Boots are military-grade synthetic leather, scuffed from regular use. No visible corporate branding. A single piece of jewelry: a silver ring on his left middle finger, worn thin — the origin is not discussed.
